SELECT DISTINCT
    s.BPSNUM_0   AS SUPPLIER_CODE,
    s.BPSNAM_0   AS SUPPLIER_NAME,
    s.BPSSHO_0   AS SUPPLIER_SHORT_NAME
FROM DWD_PURCHASE_ORDER_DTL d
JOIN DIM_SUPPLIER s
  ON d.SUPPLIER_CODE = s.BPSNUM_0
WHERE d.ITEM_CODE = 'A0001'
ORDER BY s.BPSNUM_0 ASC;

WITH 
-- 1. 采购订单数据（近12个月）
PO_DATA AS (
    SELECT 
        po.SUPPLIER_CODE,
        po.PO_NO,
        po.PO_LINE_NO,
        po.ORDER_DATE
    FROM DWD_PURCHASE_ORDER_DTL po
    WHERE po.SUPPLIER_CODE IN ('S0001', 'S0002', 'S0003')
      AND po.ORDER_DATE >= DATE '2025-12-01'
      AND po.ORDER_DATE < DATE '2026-12-01'
),
-- 2. 到货单数据（近12个月）
ARR_DATA AS (
    SELECT 
        a.SUPPLIER_CODE,
        a.PO_NO,
        a.PO_LINE_NO,
        a.ARR_DATE,
        a.ARR_QTY,
        a.QUALIFIED_QTY,
        a.DOC_STATUS_CODE
    FROM DWD_ARRIVAL_ORDER_DTL a
    WHERE a.SUPPLIER_CODE IN ('S0001', 'S0002', 'S0003')
      AND a.ARR_DATE >= DATE '2025-12-01'
      AND a.ARR_DATE < DATE '2026-12-01'
),
-- 3. 收货单数据（近12个月）
RCV_DATA AS (
    SELECT 
        r.SUPPLIER_CODE,
        r.PO_NO,
        r.PO_LINE_NO,
        r.RCV_DATE,
        r.RCV_QTY_PUU
    FROM DWD_GOODS_RECEIPT_DTL r
    WHERE r.SUPPLIER_CODE IN ('S0001', 'S0002', 'S0003')
      AND r.RCV_DATE >= DATE '2025-12-01'
      AND r.RCV_DATE < DATE '2026-12-01'
),
-- 4. 汇总各供应商的订单、到货、收货指标
AGG_PO AS (
    SELECT 
        SUPPLIER_CODE,
        COUNT(PO_NO) AS PO_COUNT
    FROM PO_DATA
    GROUP BY SUPPLIER_CODE
),
AGG_ARR AS (
    SELECT 
        SUPPLIER_CODE,
        SUM(ARR_QTY) AS TOTAL_ARR_QTY,
        SUM(QUALIFIED_QTY) AS TOTAL_QUALIFIED_QTY,
        -- 准时交付率：假设 ARR_DATE 不晚于订单期望日期（此处简化为有到货记录即视为交付，实际可结合 EXP_RCV_DATE 计算）
        -- 由于计划中未明确准时交付的具体定义（如是否需对比 EXP_RCV_DATE），且 PO 表有 EXP_RCV_DATE，
        -- 这里计算“已到货订单行”与“总订单行”的比例作为交付率参考，或根据 DOC_STATUS_CODE 判断
        -- 根据计划聚合项：SUM(ARR_QTY), SUM(QUALIFIED_QTY)。计划中未明确列出“准时交付率”的计算公式，
        -- 但目标描述中提到“准时交付率”。通常准时交付 = 实际到货日期 <= 期望到货日期。
        -- 让我们关联 PO 表获取 EXP_RCV_DATE 来计算准时率。
        COUNT(DISTINCT PO_NO || '-' || PO_LINE_NO) AS ARR_LINE_COUNT
    FROM ARR_DATA
    GROUP BY SUPPLIER_CODE
),
AGG_RCV AS (
    SELECT 
        SUPPLIER_CODE,
        SUM(RCV_QTY_PUU) AS TOTAL_RCV_QTY
    FROM RCV_DATA
    GROUP BY SUPPLIER_CODE
),
-- 5. 计算准时交付率（基于订单行）
ON_TIME_DATA AS (
    SELECT 
        po.SUPPLIER_CODE,
        COUNT(po.PO_NO) AS TOTAL_PO_LINES,
        SUM(CASE WHEN a.ARR_DATE IS NOT NULL AND a.ARR_DATE <= po.EXP_RCV_DATE THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS ON_TIME_LINES
    FROM PO_DATA po
    LEFT JOIN ARR_DATA a 
        ON po.PO_NO = a.PO_NO AND po.PO_LINE_NO = a.PO_LINE_NO
    GROUP BY po.SUPPLIER_CODE
)
SELECT 
    s.BPSNUM_0 AS SUPPLIER_CODE,
    s.BPSNAM_0 AS SUPPLIER_NAME,
    NVL(p.PO_COUNT, 0) AS PO_COUNT,
    NVL(ar.TOTAL_ARR_QTY, 0) AS TOTAL_ARR_QTY,
    NVL(ar.TOTAL_QUALIFIED_QTY, 0) AS TOTAL_QUALIFIED_QTY,
    NVL(rc.TOTAL_RCV_QTY, 0) AS TOTAL_RCV_QTY,
    CASE 
        WHEN NVL(ot.TOTAL_PO_LINES, 0) = 0 THEN 0 
        ELSE ROUND(ot.ON_TIME_LINES * 100.0 / ot.TOTAL_PO_LINES, 2) 
    END AS ON_TIME_DELIVERY_RATE
FROM DIM_SUPPLIER s
LEFT JOIN AGG_PO p ON s.BPSNUM_0 = p.SUPPLIER_CODE
LEFT JOIN AGG_ARR ar ON s.BPSNUM_0 = ar.SUPPLIER_CODE
LEFT JOIN AGG_RCV rc ON s.BPSNUM_0 = rc.SUPPLIER_CODE
LEFT JOIN ON_TIME_DATA ot ON s.BPSNUM_0 = ot.SUPPLIER_CODE
WHERE s.BPSNUM_0 IN ('S0001', 'S0002', 'S0003')
ORDER BY s.BPSNUM_0 ASC;

SELECT '无法回答' AS RESULT,
       '当前可用数据表中没有质量事件、合规事件、质量事故或合规处罚等专门的质量/合规风险事实表，无法判断供应商 S0001、S0002、S0003 是否存在重大质量或合规风险' AS REASON
FROM DUAL

SELECT
    d.SUPPLIER_CODE,
    s.BPSSHO_0 AS SUPPLIER_SHORT_NAME,
    d.ITEM_CODE,
    d.PO_NO,
    d.ORDER_DATE,
    d.EXP_RCV_DATE,
    d.PO_QTY,
    d.PO_UOM
FROM DWD_PURCHASE_ORDER_DTL d
JOIN DIM_SUPPLIER s
  ON d.SUPPLIER_CODE = s.BPSNUM_0
WHERE d.SUPPLIER_CODE IN ('S0001', 'S0002', 'S0003')
  AND s.ENAFLG_0 = 2
ORDER BY
    d.SUPPLIER_CODE ASC,
    d.ORDER_DATE DESC
